title: Sonesta International Hotels Brings Exclusive Access to Billboard Latin Week
summary: Sonesta Travel Pass members had their En Vivo experience taken to the next level
contentText:
Miami got even hotter when Billboard Latin Music Week brought together some of the most influential voices shaping the future of Latin music. With over 100 guests featured on the lineup, the programming invited attendees to celebrate culture across the Latin diaspora. The exclusive conversations and star-studded performances were well worth travelling for — and Sonesta International Hotels helped fans take their experience to the next level.

Louis Mateo Polo and Marlon Mar at Billboard En Vivo presented by Sonesta International Hotels.

Brandon Todd

Billboard En Vivo, presented by Sonesta International Hotels, brought the energy to Wynwood Marketplace for an unforgettable night. The lineup featured Jay Wheeler, Zhamira, and Conep, and included lots of singing along and dancing from the crowd.

Conep performs onstage at Billboard En Vivo presented by Sonesta International Hotels

Christopher Polk

But for Sonesta Travel Pass members, the experience went beyond the stage: an exclusive Sonesta Travel Pass Lounge offered an intimate, private space right on the grounds, giving members a place to take a break from the sold-out crowd while staying close to all the action. It was the perfect way to enjoy the music, recharge, and experience Billboard En Vivo with an added level of comfort and exclusivity.

En Vivo guests enjoy the Sonesta Travel Pass VIP Lounge at En Vivo

Melody Timothee

Curated drink menu and beverages in the Sonesta Travel Pass VIP Lounge at En Vivo

From unforgettable performances to exclusive member experiences, Sonesta helped make Billboard Latin Music Week 2026 even more memorable.
